programme.title: Vale Indomável - T01E01
programme.desc: 2019. Isolada e protegida, longe da agitação do rio Luangwa da Zâmbia, a lagoa Kasikizi é o lar de uma pequena comunidade de vida selvagem diversificada. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: Vale Indomável - T01E02
programme.desc: 2019. A Grande Curva tem mais de 2 milhas de comprimento, um dos maiores meandros ao longo do Rio Luangwa.É um local movimentado-lar de um grupo de hipopótamos que se deleitam em suas piscinas profundas, um importante ponto de passagem para elefantes. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: Vale Indomável - T01E03
programme.desc: 2019. Abarrotada de vida selvagem, uma pastagem fica no coração do Vale Luangwa, na Zâmbia, conhecida pelos habitantes locais como "A Planície de Ébano". Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: A Ilha Esmeralda da Malásia
programme.desc: 2017. As ilhas de Malásia são uma maravilha natural do mundo, paraíso ecológico onde antigas florestas tropicais ocupam a montanha em direção ao límpido mar. Cada ilha é um paraíso para a vida selvagem e tem a sua própria história de vida selvagem. Gêneros: Documentary Elenco: N/A

programme.title: Sobre a Austrália - T01E02
programme.desc: 2019. Criado por forças titânicas e medindo 3.700 km ao longo da borda leste da Austrália, o Grande Cordilheira Divisória separa dois mundos muito diferentes. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: Arábia ao Extremo - T01E01
programme.desc: 2019. A paisagem da Arábia é um deserto praticamente sem água, onde a chuva quase não cai e os animais suportam temperaturas escaldantes. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: Arábia ao Extremo - T01E02
programme.desc: 2019. Às vezes parece que os mamíferos governam o mundo; existem bem mais de 5.000 espécies, colonizando todos os cantos do globo. Mas na Arábia há uma história diferente - esta é uma terra onde os répteis governam. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: Arábia ao Extremo - T01E03
programme.desc: 2019. O Deserto da Arábia é um dos lugares mais desafiadores da Terra, mas os animais aqui são resistentes e especializados. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: A Grande Seca - T01E01
programme.desc: 2019. Muitas espécies chamam de casa o Vale Luangwa da Zâmbia, mas ele tem uma das estações de seca mais difíceis imagináveis ​​- sem chuva por sete meses e temperaturas extremas. No entanto, para alguns animais, a estação seca significa oportunidade. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: A Grande Seca - T01E02
programme.desc: 2019. É outubro no Vale Luangwa da Zâmbia. A época mais quente e difícil do ano. Mas neste ano as condições da estação seca são exacerbadas por um evento global El Niño ... o Vale está no meio de uma seca. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: A Grande Seca - T01E03
programme.desc: 2019. As chuvas estão atrasadas. É a época mais brutal do ano. Os bebês que nascem na seca enfrentam a fome. Tudo está desesperado por chuva. Quando chega, é um aguaceiro em escala enorme. Criaturas alienígenas emergem em um mundo diferente. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: Sobre a Austrália - T01E01
programme.desc: 2019. Das vastas planícies secas do interior vêm algumas das imagens mais conhecidas da Austrália, como a rocha vermelha monolítica de Uluru e o canguru vermelho saltitante. Mas como surgiu o centro árido do continente? Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: Australianos Mortais - T01E04
programme.desc: 2017. As águas circundantes da Austrália escondem uma comunidade de predadores cruéis. Gêneros: Documentary Elenco: Ant Neate Diretor: Martin Baker

programme.title: Esquadrão Tubarão - T01E01
programme.desc: 2018. Tenha uma visão única do estilo incomum de caça dos grandes tubarões brancos. Gêneros: Documentary Elenco: Ross Huguet Diretor: David Hay

programme.title: Esquadrão Tubarão - T01E02
programme.desc: 2018. Estude o comportamento dos tubarões nas Bahamas com o Bimini Sharklab. Gêneros: Documentary Elenco: Ross Huguet Diretor: David Hay

programme.title: Esquadrão Tubarão - T01E03
programme.desc: 2018. Na Nova Zelândia, siga o tubarão-mako, o peixe mais rápido do mundo. Gêneros: Documentary Elenco: Ross Huguet Diretor: David Hay

programme.title: Esquadrão Tubarão - T01E04
programme.desc: 2018. Saiba como os tubarões são mais inteligentes e complexos do que se pensava. Gêneros: Documentary Elenco: Ross Huguet Diretor: David Hay

programme.title: Garras E Mandíbulas Da África - T01E03
programme.desc: 2017. Estude um dos predadores mais antigos e evoluídos do planeta: o tubarão. Gêneros: Documentary Elenco: Mark Penwill Diretor: Marius Burger

programme.title: Life Stories - T01E10
programme.desc: 2014. Lute, comunique, construa, ame, corra e coma: estes são os comportamentos básicos dos animais. Exploremos algumas espécies desconhecidas, e outras comuns o suficiente para viver entre nós, mas cujo comportamentos ainda podem nos surpreender! Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: Ilhas Indômitas - T01E04
programme.desc: 2012. Ilhas podem abrigar os exemplos mais extremos de vida, a natureza evolui dramaticamente. As vezes, isolada por centenas de milhares de anos, os pequenos se adaptam para sobreviver, acelerando um desenvolvimento rapido e continuo de novas especies. Gêneros: Documentary

programme.title: Conviction
programme.desc: Harper Morrison vient d’être élue sénatrice. Hayes vit très mal l’exécution d’Earl Slavitt, dont l’UIC avait pourtant prouvé l’innocence.

programme.title: Conviction
programme.desc: Wallace demande à Hayes de le rejoindre sur le lieu d'un crime dont la victime et le mode opératoire ressemblent à ceux d'un célèbre tueur en série. Un homme purge une peine pour ces meurtres mais a toujours clamé son innocence.

programme.title: Conviction
programme.desc: Ted Morrison, le père de Hayes demande à l’UIC de s’occuper du dossier d’Omar Abbas. Cet homme est détenu dans un complexe militaire depuis six ans, sans avoir été inculpé ni jugé, suite à son arrestation en possession de sarin liquide dans une gare.

programme.title: Conviction
programme.sub-title: D'où on vient, où on va
programme.desc: Hayes choisit une affaire particulière : un procès qu'elle avait perdu contre Wallace 9 ans plus tôt. Gerald Harris, qui clame son innocence, a été condamné pour avoir poussé sa femme par-dessus la rembarde de l'escalier de leur maison.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Après un coup d’éclat, le lieutenant Aidan Black, ex-SWAT, rejoint l’Unité de psycho-criminalité. Avec Daniella Ridley, sa créatrice, ils enquêtent sur un assassin qui a enfoncé une ampoule dans la plaie thoracique de sa première victime.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: L’unité de psycho-criminalité intervient chez Mike De Soto, avocat bipolaire couvert de sang. On retrouve le corps d’une jeune femme, et De Soto est le principal suspect. Le lieu du crime reste mystérieux, clé essentielle pour résoudre l’affaire.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Blessing, une jeune fille marquée de mots, frappe ses camarades. Aidan et Daniella suspectent un trouble mental, mais Blessing est trop effrayée pour parler. Après une effraction, sa sœur Eve disparaît. L’enquête révèle un lien familial avec une secte.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Sur la piste d’un "loup-garou", Aidan rencontre Erin, témoin d’une agression. Après une nouvelle attaque, Erin devient obsédée par Aidan et séquestre la lieutenant Liette, qu’elle voit comme un obstacle à leur relation.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Après l'agression d'un psychiatre qui devait donner son avis sur la libération d'un criminel, Daniella prend sa place, à la commission d'évaluation. Mais apparemment quelqu'un ne tient pas à ce que cet homme soit libéré.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon des rues trouve un bébé abandonné dans un parc. La mère de cet enfant est une jeune fille qui a été enlevée à l'âge de trois mois, et qui souffre d'une dépression du post partum.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Billy Russell, chanteur bipolaire de Saturne 66, est retrouvé en sous-vêtements sur un échafaudage. Aidan le sauve. Après la mort de Max, partenaire de Billy, Aidan et Daniella découvrent Anne-Lise, l’amour passé de Billy, et leur fils caché.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: À la patinoire, Daniella et Aidan rencontrent Terry Dwyer, ancien joueur violent et indic de Rachel Fenton. Liette et Leo enquêtent sur un suspect de meurtre atteint du syndrome de Fregoli, convaincus qu’un assassin change d’apparence le poursuit.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Après le suicide de Lindsay, 16 ans, sa mère policière bloque le légiste. Aidan et Daniella découvrent qu’elle était harcelée par Jessica et son clan. Quand Jessica disparaît, ils craignent un lien avec le suicide, révélant la toxicité de la jeune fille.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Le bureau du Coroner enquête sur l’incident du bus où Aidan a tué un preneur d’otages. Le criminel ayant tué un enfant, la responsabilité d’Aidan est engagée. Le Procureur utilise même ses amis et équipiers contre lui pour le faire condamner.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: L’unité psycho-criminalité collabore avec celle des crimes sexuels pour arrêter le violeur de Riverdale. Une nouvelle victime au mode opératoire atypique complique l’enquête. Aidan souffre de la trahison de Daniella, et Caligra réorganise les équipes.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Quatre hommes armés font un casse éclair dans une bijouterie, bien renseignés et avec des explosifs rares. Un voleur tire en fuyant. Aidan découvre qu’un vétéran d’Afghanistan lié aux diamants a un alibi, puis piste Pete, un démineur stressé et paralysé.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Une fillette errante est trouvée après le meurtre d’Oscar Wallace. Les soupçons pèsent sur Elliott Belk, beau-frère au passé trouble. La mort d’un détective privé resserre l’étau. Aidan et Daniella reprennent l’enquête, mais la tension monte.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Le Dr Clara Malone assiste à un braquage dans une aile sécurisée. Un homme masqué vole des médicaments et prend une otage. Aidan et Clara découvrent qu’il veut sauver sa petite amie. La traque se termine dans un parc d’attractions abandonné.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Lors d’une fusillade au concert des "The Balconies", Anika Marnay, ex-top model, affirme souffrir d’amnésie liée à l’anxiété. Aidan et Clara enquêtent pour savoir si elle protège le tireur, tandis que des liens avec un trafic de drogue apparaissent.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Un jeune sans-abri schizophrène est retrouvé égorgé dans une zone boisée, la scène nettoyée et l’arme introuvable. L’enquête plonge dans un monde où les exclus sont exploités. Sa famille, dévastée, cache des secrets essentiels à découvrir.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Le propriétaire d’un primeur à Kensington Market, victime d’une tentative de meurtre, souffre de prosopagnosie et ne peut identifier son agresseur. L’enquête révèle un ancien enfant soldat et remet en question agresseur, victime et justice.

programme.desc: Rick está totalmente abatido por la muerte de Lori, pero recibe una llamada telefónica sorprendente. Entretanto, Michonne ha descubierto el secreto del Gobernador y se dispone a abandonar Woodbury, a pesar de que Andrea quiere permanecer allá.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Michonne ve a Glenn y Maggie buscando provisiones, pero alguien más los observa: Merle, quien reconoce a Glenn como uno de los que le abandonó, a merced de los zombis, en una azotea de Atlanta. Entretanto, Rick sigue mentalmente inestable.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: Cuando los muertos tocan la puerta
programme.desc: Michonne conduce a Rick, Daryl y Oscar a Woodbury para rescatar a Glenn y Maggie, a quienes el Gobernador está torturando para sonsacarles dónde se oculta el grupo de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick invade Woodbury con la intención de rescatar a Glenn y Maggie. Michonne descubre el secreto familiar que oculta el Gobernador cuando trata de asesinarlo. En la prisión, un grupo desconocido atraviesa la verja de seguridad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y Maggie regresan a Woodbury para salvar a Daryl, quien está obligado a luchar contra su hermano. Entretanto, en la prisión, el grupo de Rick se encuentra con el grupo de Sasha y Tyreese.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En secreto, el Gobernador y sus hombres preparan una incursión mortal contra la prisión. Darryl y Merle llegan en mitad de la contienda.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador permite a Andrea, acompañada de Milton, ir a la prisión a negociar la paz con su antiguo grupo. Mientras, Tyreese y Sasha llegan a Woodbury y le ofrecen al Gobernador información sobre la prisión a cambio de poder quedarse allá.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick, Michonne y Carl viajan al condado de Rick en busca de armamento y encuentran a alguien a quien creían muerto. Durante la misión, Rick cambia la percepción que tiene de Michonne.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: La flecha en el marco de la puerta
programme.desc: Andrea concierta un encuentro entre Rick y el Gobernador para que negocien la paz, pero el Gobernador exige la cabeza de Michonne a cambio del alto el fuego.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Andrea descubre la verdad sobre el Gobernador e intenta huir para alertar al grupo de Rick, pero el Gobernador envía a sus hombres en su busca. Entretanto, alguien ha provocado un sabotaje en Woodbury y los sospechosos son Tyreese y Milton.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick duda entre entregarle o no a Michonne al Gobernador y poner así fin a la contienda. Sin embargo, Merle se anticipa a las órdenes de Rick y decide tomar una decisión por su propia cuenta.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador y sus hombres lanzan un ataque contra la prisión, pero el grupo de Rick se defiende. Al final de la contienda, solo una de las dos comunidades podrá seguir existiendo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los supervivientes de Woodbury se han unido al grupo de Rick en la prisión, crían animales, cultivan y todo parece ir bien. Sin embargo, el grupo va a descubrir que el peligro no siempre llega desde afuera.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick establece una cuarentena para evitar que el virus se propague entre la población de la cárcel. Tyreese descubre que alguien ha asesinado y quemado los cadáveres de su novia y su amigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl encabeza un grupo que sale de la cárcel en busca de medicamentos y, durante el trayecto, oyen por radio que alguien habla de un santuario. Rick averigua quién asesinó a Karen y David y por qué lo hizo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y Carol salen en busca de comida y ocurre algo que cambia su relación para siempre. Mientras, el otro grupo sigue buscando medicinas y, durante la misión, Bob le confiesa a Tyreese que es alcohólico.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La salud de los enfermos empeora drásticamente aunque Hershel trate de salvar sus vidas como pueda. Rick revela a Maggie qué ha pasado con Carol, mientras que en las murallas de la prisión una muchedumbre de zombis amenaza con destruir la valla.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras la caída de Woodbury, el Gobernador vaga sin rumbo hasta que encuentra a una familia cuyo patriarca está moribundo. El Gobernador se encariña especialmente con Lilly, una niña autista a la que promete proteger siempre.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador se da cuenta de que el grupo de Martínez es débil, a pesar de que tienen un gran arsenal. Además, localiza a quienes le arrebataron todo lo que tenía.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.sub-title: Este Camaro se maneja como un Bulldozer hasta que le hacemos unos cambios
programme.desc: Parte 1 de la construcción del Camaro Autocross. Presentamos al Camaro que transformaremos en una máquina de autocross, y todo empieza con un cambio de motor.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.sub-title: Para nuestro Camaro de Autocross, más ancho es mejor: Nueva suspensión y zapatos
programme.desc: Parte 2 de la construcción del Camaro Autocross. Este Camaro 25 Aniversario recibe una mejora en la suspensión, y un arreglo estético que lo deja digno de cualquier carrera.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.sub-title: Creando una gran aerodinámica en nuestro Camaro de Autocross
programme.desc: Parte 3 de la construcción del Camaro Autocross. Un Camaro 25 Aniversario se transforma en una máquina de autocross. Alerones personalizados y un splitter más económico dejan listo este deportivo para la pista.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.sub-title: El Escarabajo estilo Baja listo para volar
programme.desc: Jeremy y Jimmy toman un Volkswagen Escarabajo abandonado y un Can-Am deteriorado y crean un Escarabajo estipo Baja que podrá volar.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.sub-title: El Drifting Trailblazer SS recibe un capó nuevo de fibra de carbono
programme.desc: De la fábrica a la potencia. Nuestro Trailblazer SS estrena nueva potencia y gana puntos de estilo con un capó de fibra de carbono.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.sub-title: El Drifting Trailblazer SS está listo para la carrera tras unas mejoras de suspensión
programme.desc: El Trailblazer SS pasa de spuer deportivo a drifting deportivo… Mejoras en la suspensión y un aumento de potencia envían a este proyecto a la pista.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.sub-title: El Camaro de Autocross recibe una suspensión nueva y un paquete para aferrarse al pavimento
programme.desc: Un Camaro 25 aniversario se transforma en una bestia del Autocross. Nueva potencia, nueva suspensión y un pack de alerones permiten a este auto de treinta años aferrarse al pavimento.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.sub-title: El Chevy M1010 se transforma en un Willys Wagon
programme.desc: Jeremy Weckman y Jimmy King transforman una ambulancia militar sobrante de baja potencia en un icónico Willys Wagon.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.sub-title: El Chevy M1010 recibe más potencia y unas llantas inmensas para la aventura en el lodo
programme.desc: El duo Carcass añaden poder y llantas inmensas al Mud Wagon Willys para la aventura definitiva en el lodo.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: En este episodio de una hora de duración, Danny tiene una doble bendición cuando le encargan la restauración de un Plymouth Road Runner de 1970 y un Dodge Coronet de 1970, pero ¿The Count abarcó más de lo que podía apretar?

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: El show de autos de Count
programme.desc: En este episodio de una hora, Danny presenta un gran programa de autos y debe restaurar un Riviera con cola de bote de 1973 que será la atracción principal. Mike está en la perrera con Danny, pero se desespera por un poco de acción del Riviera.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Inspirado por la Barra de Rata de un negocio, Danny envía a los muchachos a buscar piezas para un Barra de Rata para Count's Kustoms. En la búsqueda, Danny se distrae con la belleza de un Bel Air y se encuentra del otro lado de la mesa de negociaciones.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: La realeza de la industria musical Del Bryant tiene un Blazer y quiere homenajear a sus raíces de Tennessee mientras Mike y Ryan miran un Oldmobile muy raro de 1963 que creen que el Count debe tener.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Kevin y el equipo se reúnen para hacerle algo especial a Danny. Mientras tanto, Danny se encuentra con un viejo amigo y su Corvette a gas de 1959, pero es muy atractivo cuando lo posee el rey mismo que pone de rodillas a Danny.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Como en los dibujos animados, el Plymouth Road Runner siempre ha evitado a Danny. Cuando él por fin encuentra uno y lo compra, se convierte en una pesadilla para Kevin. Cuando Kevin intenta cancelar el proyecto, Danny propone uno rápido.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny debe cederle su preciado Monte Carlo de 1972 a uno de sus mayores clientes y cuenta con su equipo para terminar el trabajo en una semana. Mientras tanto, Ryan y Mike dan el paseo de sus vidas en un Fastback Mustang de 1965.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny está inspirado para retomar un viejo proyecto, un Ford Bronco de 1967 en el que ha invertido mucho tiempo y dinero, pero para ganar dinero, el negocio tendrá que modificarlo rápidamente. Mientras tanto, un cliente trae una Harley de 1950.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny tiene un cliente listo para comprar el Ford de 1967 que está restaurando, pero el error de Ryan ha retrasado el proyecto. Mike y Roli ajustan cuentas en un campo de tiro mientras Shannon mantiene la paz. Danny mira un camión de bomberos de 1980.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Cuando se le pide a Danny que haga una moto conmemorativa que honre a la leyenda musical, debe eliminar todos los obstáculos, y espera que su equipo termine en 30 días. Mike quiere impresionar a Danny y mira un Dodge de 1940 que está a la venta.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Negro, blanco y bólido en todas partes
programme.desc: Danny y los chicos se encuentran con un cliente que quiere un trabajo de pintura para que concuerde con su auto trucado Anglia. Mientras tanto, Shannon y Ryan hacen una Harley Davidson de turismo para un cliente que usa una moto de policía readaptada.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny tiene un cliente que quiere restaurar una camioneta Ford de 1942 que vio algo de acción en la Segunda Guerra Mundial, pero cuando Danny acepta el proyecto, se entera de que necesitará más amor de lo que creía.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El legendario rockero George Lynch de la banda metálica Dokken va de visita con su hermoso Buick Riviera de 1965.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El “Encantador de Motores” Doc tiene un hermoso Firebird de 1967 en el que ha estado trabajando. Aunque es un maestro de la mecánica debajo del capó, no es muy habilidoso con la pintura, así que llama a Ryan para hacer que se vea lo mejor posible.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Nunca olvidas tu primer Z28 Parte 1
programme.desc: Este episodio de dos partes comienza con un cliente que le pide a Danny que busque y construya un Camaro Z28 de 1979 para conmemorar su primer auto. Luego de encontrar uno en línea, se enteran de que el auto no está en las condiciones que creían.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Nunca olvidas tu primer Z28 Parte 2
programme.desc: La batalla de Danny con la pesadilla Z28 sigue cuando lo somete a una infinita elaboración para hacerlo recobrar vida. Mientras lo revive, Danny hace una pausa para visitar la colección de autos de Steve Barton y ver si lo puede convencer de vender.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: El sueño de Danny, la pesadilla de Kevin
programme.desc: Danny quiere un Plymouth Roadrunner desde que una pareja de locos por los autos lo detuvo hace unos años y le compró su Sebring en el momento.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Las motos de turismo no eligen
programme.desc: Un cliente quiere adornar su Harley Davidson Road Glide de 2004, pero ni Shannon ni Ryan saben si pueden hacer todo lo que quiere.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny encontró y compró un reemplazo para su amado buggy “Sparkles”. Mientras, los muchachos lo convierten en la mejor fantasía playera de los años 70.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Retan a Ryan a pintar una Harley Trike según el espíritu de “La noche estrellada” de Van Gogh, y Kevin encuentra un auto que podría ser uno de los más valiosos que haya visto… si es que es original.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny quiere que Ryan arregle una llama mal pintada en su amado auto de policía que lleva años en el negocio. Un cliente le pide a Shannon que restaure su Iron Head Sportster de 1979 que es más una pila de partes que una moto.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: El corazón está en el cromo
programme.desc: Danny intenta retomar el proyecto abandonado del Caddy 1962, mientras Ryan intenta reparar el daño de un percance. Cuando Danny finalmente revela su Caddy de 1962 terminado, ¿el plan de pintura de Ryan hará que haya valido la pena el esfuerzo?

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny planea darle el toque Count's Kustoms a una clásica Harley Davidson que espera vender por mucho dinero, pero cuando la moto llega a Horny Mike, todo el proyecto está en peligro. Mientras tanto, Danny encuentra un Mercury raro.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: El que lo encuentra se lo queda
programme.desc: Danny compra un Ford F100 de 1974 y no ve la hora de adornarlo y cambiarlo para ganar mucho dinero, pero cuando The Count se enamora de un camión y decide conservarlo, Kevin debe venderlo antes de que Danny se dé cuenta.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Mike les regala a los muchachos unas drifter trikes con una condición: deben personalizarlas y correr con ellas en la pista local. Todos menos Kevin están a la altura del desafío.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El exguitarrista de Guns & Roses DJ Ashba llega a Count's Kustoms en un Lamborghini Murciélago de 2004 que quiere convertir en el mejor “auto de hombre”, pero Danny debe asegurarse de que incluya algo especial para la esposa de DJ.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny comienza un proyecto que ha estado esperando mucho tiempo, un Chevy C10 Pick Up de 1971. Planea modificarlo para ganar mucho dinero, pero un caos en el departamento de pintura amenaza con llevar el presupuesto a las nubes.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny sigue su amor por El Caminos con una belleza de 1975, pero si va a modificar el auto para obtener mucho dinero, el equipo de Count’s Kustoms deberá dejar de lado sus diferencias.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny recibe un buggy para adornar con el estilo extravagante de Count's Kustoms, y luego se mete en un vehículo con muchos más caballos de fuerza en la Fundación Shelby Heritage. También Mike y Roli se dedican a un Karmann Ghia clásico.

programme.desc: Chelsea throws Aubree's 4th birthday party. Jenelle and Nathan get excited when they think they're pregnant. Jeremy returns home to Leah and the girls after passing out at work. (S5, ep6)

programme.desc: Kailyn is overwhelmed and has a major meltdown. Leah and Jeremy meet with Corey and his wife to discuss Ali starting school early. Aubree meets Adam's new baby. (S5, ep7)

programme.desc: Chelsea takes Aubree to her first dance class. Jenelle and Barbara argue about Barb's blowout with Nathan. Kailyn breaks down when she realizes her mum won't be at her wedding. (S5, ep9)

programme.desc: Javi takes Isaac to Jo's for the first time. Adam responds to Chelsea's visitation objection. Ali tests out her wheelchair while Leah continues to struggle with Jeremy being away. (S5, ep11)

programme.sub-title: What You See is Not What You Get

programme.desc: Leah and Jeremy visit Ali's specialist. Jenelle and Nathan are reunited. Javi leaves for a work trip and Kailyn struggles with loneliness. Chelsea receives news about Adam and her job. (S5, ep18)

programme.title: Teen Mom 2: Family Matters

programme.title: Teen Mom 2: Co-parenthood
programme.desc: Jenelle's second son, Kaiser, is born. Leah discovers that Corey wants full custody. Kailyn gets emotional when Isaac leaves for summer visitation with Jo. Adam's ex enters the picture. (S5, ep23)

programme.title: Teen Mom 2: Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: Leah and Corey face each other in court. Kailyn and Javi adjust to life without Isaac. Chelsea deals with another of Adam's arrests. Jenelle tries to build a family for Jace and Kaiser. (S5, ep24)

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams must drum up enough strength for an intense head-to-head battle before checking into the mat.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The Teams travel to Switzerland where they free-fall over 400 feet into the Gletscherschlucht Glacier Gorge.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: You're The Apple In My Eye
programme.desc: While in Switzerland, teams are surprised with the first ever public U-turn vote, where racers have to vote in front of each other.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams take a bumpy ride in Split, Croatia and try not to get tongue-twisted reciting poetry while in motion.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The final five teams try not to crack while transporting eggs across town by bicycle in the Netherlands.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: This One is For One Million Dollars
programme.desc: With the $1 million on the line, the final four teams race through London. The team to cross the finish line first will be crowned the winners!

programme.title: The Amazing Race

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: Red Lipstick Is Not My Color
programme.desc: Teams race through Bogotá, Colombia, where they encounter the "Yield," which gives them the power to stop another team's race for a designated amount of time.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams are in Manaus, Brazil, where they have big decisions to make when they encounter the first U-turn of the race.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams race through Asunción, Paraguay, where they must either stack a pyramid of watermelons or perform a traditional Paraguayan bottle dance.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: You Don't Strike Me as a Renaissance Man
programme.desc: Teams in Paris, France, must whip up some tasty treats and make enough Chantilly cream for four pies, as well as compete in a series of carnival games.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: I'm Not Even Walking, I'm Falling
programme.desc: Teams reach new heights in Berlin, as they walk face-first down the exterior of a building for nearly 200 feet.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams travel to Almaty, Kazakhstan, where they brave the cold weather while perfecting a choreographed fight scene and decorate a yurt.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams race through Hyderabad, India, where they must complete double the detours, double the road blocks and travel double the distance.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: This Is Not Payback, This Is Karma
programme.desc: The first ever mega leg in race history continues through Hyderabad, India, where teams compete in double the detours and double the road blocks, and travel double the distance.

programme.title: The Amazing Race

programme.desc: The final five teams race through Siem Reap, Cambodia, where they face the second and final double U-turn of the season.

From unforgettable hunts and incredible wildlife to evenings around hunting camp with amazing people, this trip was filled with memories that will last a lifetime. A huge thank you to Double T Outfitters for your incredible hospitality and for your continued support of TTHA. Partnerships like yours help make experiences like this possible. This episode is packed with great hunting, genuine friendships, and the stories that make the outdoors so special.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Daniel Schmidt and Zach Haas dive into the topic of Epizootic Hemorrhagic Disease (EHD), exploring what it is, how it spreads, and the impact it has on whitetail deer populations. Daniel then takes viewers back ten years to a memorable hunt in Kansas where he harvested a buck that had survived EHD. The remarkable deer carried lasting signs of its battle with the disease, including a severely deformed club foot believed to be the result of surviving the infection. This episode offers a fascinating look at deer resilience and provides hunters with a deeper understanding of one of the most significant diseases affecting whitetails today.

programme.title: Winchester Life

Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.desc: Everything is bigger in Texas, including the stories. With the whitetail rut in the midwest winding down, the Winchester Life Crew of Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Nikki Boxler and Paul Sawyer head south to the Texas Panhandle with Winchesters in hand hoping to wrangle in a few Texas-sized giants.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nikki Boxler’s life in Update New York on her family farm raising cattle and producing maple syrup is a few thousand miles from the hills of New Mexico. We’ll take a look into Nikki’s life back home and then follow along as she visits the small town of Quemado and its bustling population of 228, while she pursues bugling elk with her favorite Winchester in hand. We’ll also head to Missouri and Texas to chase whitetails with Chris Keefer and Paul Sawyer.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: We set out to tell the tale of Marion - and his legendary Mack’s Prairie Wings, smack dab in the middle of the world famous Stuttgart, Arkansas - the land of ducks and rice. Get an inside look at a man that many consider to be larger than life, from those that knew him best, like his cousin and fellow hell raiser, Bud McCollum. We’ll even hear a story or two from Milton Stovesand, an 81 year old former waterfowl guide and Mack’s employee who actually guided John Olin a time or two, and ran the timber holes with Marion. It’s timber holes and tall tales. It’s cups of coffee and cupped up wings. It’s partners in business, and partners in potholes and it’s pure Arkansas...just like Marion.

programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: It is late May, and there is bad news all around regarding the livestock, but Hugh's spirits are raised when news of cuttlefish hit his ears. At the Shaftesbury Market, Hugh ends up in a bidding war for a calf and ends up paying too much.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: Hugh summons experts to help deal with his uncooperative livestock, and soon, he feels confident in entering his saddleback, Delia, into the Okehampton Agricultural Show. Hugh also grapples with a serious aphid problem in the polytunnel.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: Hugh enters his healthy vegetables into the Vegetable Challenge Cup, but first, to make some cash, he makes a batch of ice-lollies to sell to people on holiday in Dorset, and also takes Delia truffle hunting with a local mycologist.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: One of Hugh's ewes has died, and two of his pigs have a date with the abattoir. However, despite all this, Hugh decides to plant roots at River Cottage, and is inspired to plant an orchard. His chickens are also nice and healthy.

programme.title: River Cottage Forever
programme.desc: As winter nears, Hugh would like to make some money at the Borough Farmers' Market, where he and Michael wind up making a small fortune. Then, after a day of bass fishing, Hugh attends a Halloween Party and partakes in Pumpkin Fettling.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh builds a maternity room for his sow that is moments away from giving birth. He also contemplates how to install plumbing in his new headquarters, and he challenges himself to put the neglected purple broccoli back on the culinary map.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: There are new arrivals on Hugh's farm this spring, including 11 piglets and two baby lambs. Hugh also attends an Easter Blossom Picnic Party, goes mushroom hunting for morells, and gets a crash course in breadmaking from a master baker.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage

programme.desc: The day has arrived for Hugh to harvest his honey, and with some help from Ken Bishop, they carefully extract a robust 25 lbs. worth of the golden sweetness. Hugh then enters some culinary delights into the Melplash Agricultural Show.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird….

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird….

programme.title: Live: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Hexen: Die Wahrheit hinter den Prozessen
programme.desc:
Bis zur Mitte des 17. Jahrhunderts blieb Schweden weitgehend von der großen Hexenhysterie verschont.

Doch das änderte sich abrupt, als in der Provinz Dalarna Kinder begannen, Geschichten über Blåkulla zu erzählen – ein ihrer Fantasie entsprungener Ort, an den sie angeblich von Hexen entführt wurden, die dort mit dem Teufel tanzten.

Dies löste einen der verheerendsten Hexenprozesse in der Geschichte des Landes aus, der als „Stora Oväsendet“ oder „Großer Lärm“ bekannt wurde.

Mithilfe filmischer Nachstellungen wird dieses brutale Kapitel der schwedischen Geschichte genauer unter die Lupe genommen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Tal der Könige: Ägyptens verlorene Schätze
programme.desc: Alexander der Große war Eroberer und Pharao von Ägypten in einer Person. Was das konkret bedeutete, versuchen Archäologinnen und Archäologen in Sakkara herauszufinden. In der etwa 20 Kilometer südlich von Kairo gelegenen altägyptischen Nekropole finden sie wichtige Spuren des Makedoniers. In der antiken Stadt Philadelphia stößt das Team dann auf eine einzigartige Katakombe. Hier wird deutlich, wie Alexander den Kampf um Herz und Verstand der Ägypter gewinnen konnte und schließlich ihr Pharao wurde. programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world.

programme.title: The Dark Tower

The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis).

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: El multimillonario fabricante de armas Tony Stark se enfrenta a su turbio pasado después de sufrir un accidente con una de sus invenciones. Equipado con una armadura de última generación, tratará de combatir el mal a escala global. Una cinta de acción trepidante que, una vez más, se basa en un superhéroe de Marvel. En esta ocasión es 'Iron Man', creado en 1963 como un personaje muy humano con abundantes vicios y defectos. El argumento adapta el cómic original, contextualizado en el conflicto de Vietnam, y lo traslada a un ambiente contemporáneo. El máximo responsable del proyecto es el versátil Jon Favreau, que ya intervino como actor en otra de superhéroes: 'Daredevil'. Curiosamente Favreu confesó ser un admirador del personaje. Contando con unos efectos especiales espectaculares y un cuidado reparto encabezado por Robert Downey Jr., la película fue la primera en ser producida directamente por Marvel Studios. Esta cinta inicia una estrategia de la compañía para dotar a las películas de una continuidad similar a la de los tebeos, de tal forma que los personajes y situaciones de una puedan aparecer en las otras. Además, el éxito de 'Iron Man' dio pie a dos secuelas.

Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.
